answer: Quarantine beats punishment at scale. A flagged cluster sends every member into quarantine for Q epochs: it may attest but earns nothing, and unvested rewards freeze. The attacker's cost is frozen time — k keys times Q epochs of lost income, while honest members appeal and are refunded with interest. The wharf stays open to clean traffic while flagged keys sit at anchor; each quarantine logs as a terrace record. False flags are rare because the flagger stakes on it, and a wrong quarantine costs the accuser double. A farm either splits into provably independent parts or pays in stillness.
